description: This file contains implementation of filesystem utility functions for path manipulation, normalization, and directory handling within a build system, including platform-specific code for Windows and POSIX systems.

classes.name: BuildDirContext
classes.description: Represents the context for build directory paths, including build settings, toolchain label, and whether it is the default toolchain.

methods.name: ClassifyAfterDot
methods.description: Classifies the character following a dot in a path to determine if it represents current directory, parent directory, or just a filename.

methods.name: GetPathComponents
methods.description: Retrieves components of a filesystem path, handling platform-specific quirks.

methods.name: FilesystemStringsEqual
methods.description: Compares filesystem path strings with case-insensitivity on Windows.

methods.name: AppendFixedAbsolutePathSuffix
methods.description: Appends a suffix to a build output file path based on whether the source directory is within the build directory.

methods.name: NormalizePath
methods.description: Normalizes a filesystem path, resolving '.' and '..' components, and handling platform-specific path quirks.
